# 333_R7UX.10 — word-level diff marks in compare (BL-88)

## What

Inside a changed paragraph of the §5.8 compare view, inserted and deleted **words** now carry
stronger marks while the row keeps its block tint: the before cell strikes removed runs with
`<del data-diff-word="deleted">` and the after cell underlines added runs with
`<ins data-diff-word="inserted">`. Unchanged paragraphs are untouched; one-sided remove/add
pairs stay pure tint.

**Render contract:**

- **Pair only where it's an edit** — `wordMarks` is gated by `wordPairable`, the same coverage
  floor the hunk builder uses to call two unmatched blocks an `edited` pair instead of
  remove+add. Below the floor no word marks render — they would only restate the block tint.
- **Both layouts** — the side-by-side rows and the inline hunk list pair positionally inside
  the hunk (the hunk's own alignment), so the same run set marks the before/after cells.
- **DOM contract** — `data-diff-word` declared conditional in `dom-contract.ts` and emitted by
  the marks; the block-level `data-diff-block`/`data-diff-kind`/`data-hunk` hooks are unchanged.

## The diff engine

New `packages/findings-core/src/word-diff.ts` — no vendored helper; it mirrors the in-house
LCS shape (`source-mode.ts` `diffTopBlocks`):

- `tokenizeWords` — unicode-aware tokenization covering every character exactly once (word
  tokens including joins on `'`/`’`/`_`/`-`, whitespace runs, punctuation runs).
- `diffWords(before, after)` — prefix/suffix trim + cell-limited `Uint32Array` LCS over the
  token streams, emitting `WordRun[]` shaped deliberately like prosemirror-changeset 1.x
  `Change` (`fromA/toA/fromB/toB` + `kind`) — the seam the run ledger names for a future
  changeset-backed word diff. Past `WORD_DIFF_CELL_LIMIT` the middle degrades to one coarse
  `edited` run: bounded work, truthful marks.
- `wordCoverage`/`EDIT_PAIR_FLOOR` moved here — `what-changed.ts` imports them, so the
  hunk-kind floor and the render gate stay one definition.

## Fixed on the way

- `diffMarkdown` normalized each block's key **once per dp cell** — O(blocks²) `normalizeText`
  calls. Keys are now computed once per block (pure key ⇒ identical diff): block diff + word
  marks on a 100 KB pair measure **269.2 ms** where the repeated normalization alone ran ~1.5 s.

## Verify

- **Stage A:** 11 word-diff unit legs (token coverage, same/deleted/inserted/edited runs,
  cell-limit coarse degradation, coverage floor) + 3 compare render legs (edited pair marks
  both cells, below-floor pair renders no marks, one-sided hunk unchanged) + BL-88 dom leg —
  focused suites green; turbo build/lint/typecheck 138/138 tasks; vitest findings-core + ui +
  editor 61 files / 566 tests; web suite 1733/1736 with the 3 `settings.dom` form-post
  timeouts re-verified green at raised timeout — machine contention at load avg ~52 (the
  documented R7UX.7 flake; the file imports nothing this change touches).
  `check:dom-contract`, `check:spa-budget` (the standing +33.8 kB cumulative WARN,
  GD-KIT3A-BUDGET/GD-SPA-ENTRY.R7 — disclosed on every R7UX row), `check:spa-env`,
  `check:no-cookies` all OK.
- **Live walk (owned `pr-427`, PASS):** the demo-corpus compare route
  `/demo/structure-of-political-difference/v/1/diff/2` ($0, no sign-in, no inference)
  rendered 34 hunks / 464 cells with **263 `<del data-diff-word="deleted">`** marks (all
  in before cells, computed `line-through`) and **317 `<ins data-diff-word="inserted">`**
  marks (all in after cells, computed `underline`) — `reports/2026-11-26_r7ux10-word-diff/`
  (walk.mjs, walk-facts.json, 3 PNGs). Provenance `/healthz/` `gitSha 74c2fc3e…` = PR head.
- **The preview caught a real defect:** walk leg 1 mounted the SPA but crashed mounting
  `[data-compare]` — `token[i-1].end` indexed `token[-1]` on a mark at paragraph offset 0
  (insertion/deletion at start, or an LCS first anchor at index 0 with a one-sided gap —
  exactly what an edited demo paragraph looks like). Every Stage-A fixture shared a first
  token so the prefix trim sidestepped the gap path. Fixed in `74c2fc3e` (token bounds,
  not ends — identical offsets, never a −1 index) + 2 regression legs, redeployed and
  re-walked green.
- **Measured diff budget:** 100 KB-class pair (101,178 chars) — block diff + word marks in
  **12.9 ms** (an earlier 269.2 ms read ran under load-avg ~52 machine contention).
